_comment: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqchat-vectors.mjs (src/pqchat.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. Sources: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-ua7-pq-e2e-sessions.md (§4, §6, §7, §10), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-pqchat-public-topics.md (§2), plan block "Group 3c" (3C-D3, 3C-D5, 3C-D9). UNAUDITED. Messages and transports (spec §6.3–§6.5, P15, P25, P29, §4.2, P22). HKDF = HKDF-SHA-256, empty salt, 32 B; device = bytes16, a 16-byte UUID (RFC 9562), v7 or v4 at the client's choice, nothing checks its version or variant bits (owner 2026-11-10); its 16 raw bytes in every derivation; devices: the values used here, any fixed 16 bytes, keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/device/<name>")[0:16]. chains: ck0 = HKDF(K, "scaas/pqchat/v1/chain" ‖ sessionId ‖ epochId ‖ sender ‖ device); step i: mk = HMAC-SHA-256(ck_i, 0x01), n = HMAC-SHA-256(ck_i, 0x03)[0:12], ck = ck_{i+1} = HMAC-SHA-256(ck_i, 0x02). padding (3C-D9): pt = u32be(len) ‖ content ‖ zeros to the smallest of 256, 1,024, 4,096, 16,384 B, then multiples of 16,384 B, holding 4 + len; a row's content is `length` bytes, byte i = i mod 251; ptKeccak256 = keccak256(pt). message: content = canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace), pt = pad(UTF-8 content), aad = abi.encode(sessionId, epochId, sender, bytes16 device, uint64 counter, keccak256(abi.encode(bytes32[] parents))), ciphertext = AES-256-GCM-SIV(mk_counter, n_counter, pt, aad) = records.json message.record.ciphertext. envelope: hint = HMAC-SHA-256(K, "scaas/pqchat/v1/hint")[0:8]; kEnv = HKDF(K, "scaas/pqchat/v1/env" ‖ sessionId ‖ epochId); inner = abi.encode(PqChatMessage, UASig) of records.json message (the bytes postMessage takes); env = nonce ‖ AES-256-GCM-SIV(kEnv, nonce, inner), empty AAD. payload: abi.encode(uint8 v = 1, bytes8 hint, bytes env), the HCS message and the storeMessage blob. matrixEvent: content {v, hint, env}, hint and env in standard base64 (RFC 4648 §4, with padding). sealedInfo: nonce ‖ AES-256-GCM-SIV(kInfo = HKDF(K, "scaas/pqchat/v1/info" ‖ sessionId ‖ epochId), nonce, pt = pad(UTF-8 json)), json = canonical JSON of info. callKeys: callBase = HKDF(K ‖ callSecret (group; K alone for 1:1), "scaas/pqchat/v1/call" ‖ sessionId ‖ epochId ‖ callId (32 B) ‖ u32be callEpoch); baseKey = HKDF(callBase, "scaas/pqchat/v1/sframe" ‖ sender ‖ device). No SFrame KID rows (RFC 9605 S not stated), no libp2p or Waku rows. chainFar: the step at counter 5,000 of the first chain, walked from ck0 (CLI-PQC-14: a reader keeps no skipped key and walks at most 2^20 steps from a position it holds). canonicalJson: input (JSON text) and its canonical form, keys sorted by UTF-16 code units, JSON.stringify escapes, numbers only integers within +-(2^53 - 1); canonicalRefused: inputs refused. unpadRefused: padded texts unpad refuses, each one change from its twin (pad of content), which opens. fileMessage (UA-7 §6.4.1 with its 2026-11-21 Change, pqchat-core T10b): file = rnd(fileSeed, size); the object = arweave.js sealForArweave(appRoot, fileKey, file, signatureType) (objects.json's frame, bucket(size) + 16 B, ctSha256 its SHA-256; url ar://<id> of the item); sealed = the canonical JSON the sealer is given (every field but key); content = the sealer's result, sealed plus key = fileKey (lower-case 0x hex), canonical; record = a PqChatMessage of alice's device alice-1 at counter 3 in epoch 1 (its one parent the message row's id), ciphertext = AES-256-GCM-SIV(mk_3, n_3, pad(UTF-8 content), aad); id = typed(record); env = nonce envNonce ‖ AES-256-GCM-SIV(kEnv, envNonce, inner). The reader: the content checked (type file, mediaType 1-64 B, name 1-255 B, size an integer 1 to 2^36 - 32, sha256, ctSha256 and key 0x hex of 32 B, url ar:// only, store optional {kind 1-32 B, locator 1-2,048 B}; else "file"), then before any decryption the object's exact length (FileLength) and SHA-256 = ctSha256 (FileHashMismatch), then the tag (Aead), the frame (FileFrame) and sha256 (FileHashMismatch). fileContentRefused: contents the check refuses ("file"), each one change from twin; fileSealRefused: what the sealer refuses to be given (a key, another type); fileOpenRefused: the row's object or content changed once, each with its error (null: opens).
